problem: Wave had not seen the user adoption Google wanted, and users found its tools hard to grasp.
title: Google stops developing Wave a year after release
context: Google Wave was a real-time collaboration tool introduced in May 2009.
decision_made: Stop developing Wave as a stand-alone product and maintain it until the end of the year.
action_taken: Announced on the Official Google Blog, offered export tools and said the technology would be reused in other projects.
observed_outcome: The product was shut down; Google reused parts of the technology and open-sourced components.
lessons: A powerful but unfamiliar product can fail to find users even with strong backing.
limitations: Commentary on causes, such as usability or lack of Internet Explorer support, is opinion.

claims.claim_text: Google said it would stop developing Wave as a stand-alone product.
Google said Wave had not seen the user adoption it would have liked.
Google said it would stop developing Wave as a stand-alone product, maintain it through the end of the year and reuse the technology in other projects.
